entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: Sorceress of the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria, a blood magic user who tried to incite war between elves and minotaurs.

entities.name: Lord Peemel
entities.description: Gave Sacumon her orders to incite war.

entities.name: Niroso
entities.description: Warmongering stone people who sent coal golems to attack.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Minotaur manipulated and cursed by Sacumon, later saved by Maeveen.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: Saved Yunnie and brought him back to the battlefront.

entities.name: Mytaru
entities.description: Minotaur shaman who brought forth the stone avatar of Tiyint.

entities.name: Tiyint
entities.description: Stone avatar brought forth by Mytaru.

events.summary: Sacumon is ordered by Lord Peemel to incite war between the elves and the minotaurs and works with the Niroso and their coal golems.
events.quote: she was to incite a war between the elves of Eln Forest and the minotaurs of Urhaalan Valley

events.summary: Sacumon gives Yunnie the cursed Living Armor and uses blood magic to make him forget and be unable to speak of her.
events.quote: Sacumon proffered the Living Armor to Yunnie

events.summary: Yunnie is disgraced but saved by Maeveen and brought back to the front.
events.quote: ultimately saved by Maeveen O'Donagh and brought back to the battlefront

events.summary: Mytaru brings forth the stone avatar of Tiyint, devastating the north.
events.quote: Mytaru used his shamanic magic to bring forth the stone avatar of Tiyint

events.summary: Yunnie and Coernn best Sacumon in the caves of the Niriso, and she dies, fading into a dried husk.
events.quote: When she died, she faded into a dried husk

relations.quote: Sacumon received orders from Lord Peemel
She worked with the warmongering stone people named the Niroso
Yunnie and Coernn finally bested Sacumon
